Subject: Request: Hosted API penetration test report (latest)

Hi Stephanie,

We're preparing for our SOC 2 Type II evidence collection and need the most recent penetration test report for Redwood's hosted API environment (production). Can you confirm the scope (network, auth, multi-tenant isolation) and provide: 

- The latest full penetration test report (redacted as appropriate)
- A remediation status summary (open/closed with dates)

Thanks,
Tessa Reynolds

Hi Tessa — thanks for the request and the timing note. We can definitely provide the report and a remediation summary. A few quick items / options so we can deliver in a way that fits your audit controls: 

Delivery options (please pick one):
- S3 presigned URL (TLS, single-use recommended): link valid for 48-72 hours; we can require a one-time password delivered separately.
- Gated download via our customer portal (SAML SSO): requires you to confirm an account/email that supports SSO.
- Encrypted package in a customer vault (Box/ShareFile) with customer-managed key access.

Scope notes: our latest test covered external network vectors, API authentication flows, token leakage scenarios, and multi-tenant auth/authorization checks. We did not perform physical on-premise testing. I will attach a high-level scope summary and our remediation CSV.

On the paperwork side: we can operate under the mutual NDA you previously signed; if you need a separate one for this package, we can execute quickly.

I'll coordinate with Security Ops (cc'd) to prepare the files and a short remediation summary (open/closed status + planned fixes). If you can confirm the preferred delivery option and whether you require redaction of customer-identifying data, I'll prioritize the most secure route.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
